maṅgala: [Maṅga=magi+ala] (pu,na) CL=7 [Maṅganti sattā etena vuddhiṃ gacchantīti maṅgalaṃ. Moga, 7. 182. Nīti, dhā. 27. Dhāna, ṭī. 88.] (Na) (1) The dhamma that can be flourished. That is blessed and auspicious. (2) Blessing such as Dīṭṭha Suta. (According to time someone can see the sense which should be designated the goodness that is Diṭṭha maṅgala. can hear the voice that should be designated goodness which is called Suta maṅgalā. Someone enjoys the good smell, taste, and touch that are called Muta maṅgalā.  sattani, ṭṭha, 2. 1).(pu)(3) Maṅgala Buddha. (4) A Hermit named Maṅgala. (5) A Brahmin named Maṅgala. (6) A young man named Maṅgala. (7) A slave named Maṅgala. (8) A mansion named Maṅgala. (9) An elephant named Maṅgala. (Ti) (10) One who is an auspicious man. (Ti) One who is a great man. See - Maṅgalamahāpurisa. See original.
maṅgalaassanhānatittha: [Maṅgalaassa+nhānatittha] (na) CL=7 A state horse. The bathing place (or) the bathing place of a state horse.
maṅgalabodhisatta: [Maṅgala+bodhisatta] (pu) CL=7 A future Buddha named Maṅgala.
maṅgaladivasa: [Maṅgala+divasa] (pu) CL=7 The blessing day (or) festive day (or) day of marriage.
maṅgaladosa: [Maṅgala+dosa] (pu) CL=7 (A) The flaw that is Maṅgala (such as Diṭṭha, suta). (B) Blessing and flaw. The flaw that believes in Maṅgala (such as Diṭṭha, suta) and Uppāta book. See - Maṅgaladosavippahīna.
maṅgaladosavippahīna: [Maṅgaladosa+vippahīna] (ti) CL=7 One who has rejected the flaw of Maṅgala (such as Diṭṭha, suta).
maṅgaladosavītivatta: [Maṅgaladosa+vītivatta] (ti) CL=7 One who overcomes Maṅgala and flaws.
maṅgalaguṇa: [Maṅgala+guṇa] (pu) CL=7 The authentic quality of Blessing. See - Maṅgalasampanna.
maṅgalagāthā: [Maṅgalā+gāthā] (thī) CL=7 The blessed verse. Maṅgala verse.
maṅgalahatthigopaka: [Maṅgalahatthi+gopaka] (pu) CL=7 A guard of a state elephant.
maṅgalahatthisālā: [Maṅgalahatthī+sālā] (thī) CL=7 The house of a state elephant. The state elephant"s house.
maṅgalahatthiṭṭhāna: [Maṅgalahatthī+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 The place of the state elephant. A state elephant"s house.
maṅgalahatthī: [Maṅgala+hatthī] (pu) CL=7 (A) The blessed elephant. A state elephant. See - Maṅgalaassa. See also - Maṅgala-(9). (B) An elephant who is being in the Maṅgala family.
maṅgalakamma: [Maṅgala+kamma] (na) CL=7 The auspicious work. The blessed action.
maṅgalakamyatā: [Maṅgalakamya+tā] (thī) CL=7 [See - Kattukamyatā]. Desire to do the blessing work. Wanting to do auspicious deeds.
maṅgalakaraṇa: [Maṅgala+karaṇa] (na) CL=7 Making marriage (or) doing the blessing action.
maṅgalakicca: [Maṅgala+kicca] (na) CL=7 The blessing work or action. an obligation that is blessed.
maṅgalakiriya: [Maṅgala+kiriya] (thī,na) CL=7 The auspicious work (or) ceremony. Offering something due to blessing.
maṅgalakiriyādivasa: [Maṅgalakiriyā+divasa] (pu) CL=7 The day of an auspicious ceremony.
maṅgalakolāhala: [Maṅgala+kolāhala] (pu,na) CL=7 Dispute about auspicious things or acts. See - Kolāhala.
maṅgalakāma: [Maṅgala+kāma] (ti) CL=7 One who is wanting to be blessed. See - Kāma.
maṅgalamaha: [Maṅgala+maha] (pu) CL=7 An auspicious ceremony (or) a marriage ceremony.
maṅgalamahāpurisa: [Maṅgala+mahāpurisa] (pu) CL=7 A privately enlightened Buddha named Maṅgala.
maṅgalamaṇiratana: [Maṅgala+maṇiratana] (na) CL=7 An auspicious precious gem (such as ruby).
maṅgalanimantana: [Maṅgala+nimantana] (ti) CL=7 A place to invite for the auspicious ceremony.
maṅgalanti: Maṅgalanti (Khuddaka,ṭṭha. 103. Suttani,ṭṭha. 2.9) that words come from Maṅganti. Tipi,16,86.
maṅgalapariyāya: [Maṅgala+pariyāya] (pu) CL=7 (A) Blessing sermon. (B) The deception of blessing.
maṅgalapatthanakāla: [Maṅgalapatthanā+kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of longing for blessing.
maṅgalapañha: [Maṅgala+pañha] (ti) CL=7 The question of what is auspicious?
maṅgalapañhakathana: [Maṅgalapañha+kathana] (na) CL=7 Answering the question of what is auspicious.
maṅgalapañhasamuṭṭhāna: [Maṅgalapañha+samuṭṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A cause of happening question of what is auspicious.
maṅgalapaṭipadā: [Maṅgala+paṭipadā] (thī) CL=7 A path of the auspicious practice. The practice that causes flourishment.
maṅgalapokkharaṇipākāramatthaka: [Maṅgalapokkharaṇī+pākāramatthaka] (pu,na) CL=7 The top of the embankment of the royal bathing pond.
maṅgalapokkharaṇitīra: [Maṅgalapokkharaṇī+tīra] (na) CL=7 The beach (or) shore of the royal bathing pond.
maṅgalapokkharaṇītīra: [Maṅgalapokkharaṇī+tīra] (na) CL=7 The beach (or) shore of the royal bathing pond.
maṅgalapāsāda: [Maṅgala+pāsāda] (pu) CL=7 The auspicious mansion (or) A royal mansion.
maṅgalapāyāsa: [Maṅgala+pāyāsa] (pu) CL=7 The sacred milk rice porridge.
maṅgalaratha: [Maṅgala+ratha] (pu) CL=7 The auspicious coach. See also - Phussaratha.
maṅgalasakkāra: [Maṅgala+sakkāra] (pu) CL=7 Things to do for a wedding.
maṅgalasakunta: [Maṅgala+sa+kunta] (pu) CL=7 The auspicious scepter lance (or) spear. (Lomasapāṇaka. Vi,ṭṭha,2111, lomasanāgatthera. In Ma,ṭṭha,1. 81 it translates Assatthi as Sa-saddā. In Thera,ṭṭha,2.325- having "maṅgalāvudha", Maṅgalakunta should be translated as an auspicious spear).
maṅgalasammata: [Maṅgala+sammata] (ti) CL=7 Considered to be Maṅgala that is a cause of prosperity.
maṅgalasaṃyutta: [Maṅgala+saṃyutta] (ti) CL=7 Connected to blessing. Have blessed.
maṅgalasilā: [Maṅgalā+silā] (thī) CL=7 An auspicious flatted stone (or) auspicious stone mat.
maṅgalasilātala: [Maṅgalasilā+tala] (na) CL=7 The surface of an auspicious stone mat.
maṅgalasindhava: [Maṅgala+sindhava] (pu) CL=7 State horse (or) State flying horse.
maṅgalasuttapariyosāna: [Maṅgalasutta+pariyosāna] (na) CL=7 The end of teaching Maṅgala sutta.
maṅgalasuttavaṇṇanā: [Maṅgalasutta+vaṇṇanā] (thī) CL=7 Opening of Maṅgala sutta. Maṅgala sutta sermon.
maṅgalasuttaṭṭhakathā: [Maṅgalasutta+aṭṭhakathā] (thī) CL=7 Maṅgalasutta commentary.  A detailed explanation of the meaning of Maṅgalasutta.
maṅgalasālamūla: [Maṅgalasāla+mūla] (na) CL=7 Near the auspicious sal tree.
maṅgalasālarukkhamūla: [Maṅgalasālarukkha+mūla] (na) CL=7 Near the auspicious sal tree.
maṅgalasālavana: [Maṅgala+sālavana] (na) CL=7 A forest where auspicious sal trees dense grow.
maṅgalasālā: [Maṅgalā+sālā] (thī) CL=7 The royal home (or) blessed home (or) royal palace.
maṅgalathambha: [Maṅgala+thambha] (pu) CL=7 The sacred post or pillar.
maṅgalattha: [Maṅgala+attha] (pu) CL=7 (1) The auspicious benefit. (Ti) (2) (An affairs or matter) that has an auspicious benefit.
maṅgalatthambha: [Maṅgala+thambha] (pu) CL=7 The sacred post or pillar.
maṅgalatthika: [Maṅgala+atthika] (ti) CL=7 One who is wanting to bless.
maṅgalausabha: [Maṅgala+usabha] (pu) CL=7 State ox (or) the sacred ox. See - Maṅgalaassa.
maṅgalavappa: [Maṅgala+vappa] (na) CL=7 Planting sacred or auspicious seeds.
maṅgalavatthayuga: [Maṅgala+vatthayuga] (pu) CL=7 Suit of clothes for the auspicious ceremony (or) wedding ceremony.
maṅgalavāsī: [Maṅgala+vasa+ṇī] (ti) CL=7 One who lives in the royal place (or) blessed place.
maṅgalavīthi: [Maṅgalā+vīthi] (thī) CL=7 An auspicious path (or) noble eightfold path.
maṅgalayutta: [Maṅgala+yutta] (ti) CL=7 Yoked with blessing. See - Maṅgalanakkhatta.
maṅgalaṭṭha: [Maṅgala+attha] (ti) CL=7 That has a blessed meaning or auspicious meaning.
maṅgalaṭṭhāna: [Maṅgala+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A place of doing auspicious affairs.
maṅgalika: [Maṅgala+ika] (ti) CL=7 (1) Compared with blessed words (sound). One who is speaking or chanting auspicious words (sound).
maṅgaluyyāna: [Maṅgala+uyyāna] (na) CL=7 A blessed garden (or) royal garden. See - Maṅgalamahāpurisa.
maṅgalya: [Maṅgala+ṇya] (ti) CL=7 (Ruby) that should be designated a blessing.
maṅgalābharaṇabhūsita: [Maṅgalābharaṇa+bhūsita] (ti) CL=7 One who is adorned with auspicious ornaments.
maṅgalāvāsanāmaka: [Maṅgalāvāsa+nāmaka] (ti) CL=7 A monastery (or) resident named Maṅgalā.
maṅgana: [Maṅga+yu] (na) CL=7 Repulsive in appearance (or) hideously ugly. See - Maṅguli.
maṅgulabījaka: [Maṅgula+bījaka] (na) CL=7 Small eggs of a bed bug.
maṅguladaṭṭha: [Maṅgula+daṭṭha] (pu) CL=7 Bite by a bed bug.
maṅgulagūthabharita: [Maṅgulagūtha+bharita] (ti) CL=7 Filled with the excrement of bed bugs.
maṅgulapiṭṭhi: [Maṅgula+piṭṭhi] (thī) CL=7 The back of a bed bug.
maṅgulasodhanadaṇḍaka: [Maṅgulasodhana+daṇḍaka] (pu) CL=7 A small stick that is to kill (or) clean bed bugs.
maṅgulaṇḍaka: [Maṅgula+aṇḍaka] (na) CL=7 Small eggs of a bed bug.
maṅguli: [Maṅga+ula+i] (ti) CL=7 One who is very ugly.
maṅgulitthivatthu: [Maṅgulitthī+vatthu] (na) CL=7 A story that explains an ugly woman.
maṅgulitthī: [Maṅguli+itthī] (thī) CL=7 An ugly woman. See - Maṅgulitthivatthu.
maṅgura: [Maṅga+ura] (pu) CL=7 [Amaṅgi pasatthamagamītimaṅguro. Moga,7.148.] (1) A catfish. See - Maṅguracchavi. (2) A bed bug. See - Maṅguraṇḍaka, Maggura, Maṅgula.
maṅguracchavi: [Maṅguracchavi+chavi] (ti) CL=7 [Maaūsyha.] One whose skin color is like the color of a  catfish. Maṅguracchavi(vi,ṭṭha,1.203)nāma sāmo. Vajira. 93-aliu maṅguracchavi, one whose skin color resembles gold. In Ma,2.syha.213.ma,1. Mranamāprana. 320. Dī,ṭṭha,2. Syha, one whose skin resembles the back of a bed bug. In that Myanmar translation, whose skin color is brown. In Dī, 1. 178- Syha, one whose skin color has spots like the back of a lizard. In Maaūsya,3.144, one whose skin is like the skin of a bed bug, that is translated differently).
maṅguramacchacchavi: [Maṅguramacchacchavi+chavi] (ti) CL=7 One whose appearance is like the appearance of a catfish. See - Maṅguracchavi.
maṅguraṇḍaka: [Maṅgura+aṇḍaka] (na) CL=7 Small eggs of bed bugs.
maṅku: [Maki+u] (ti) CL=7 One who is powerless, unhappy, and without glory.
maṅkubhūta: [Maṅku+bhūta] (ti) CL=7 One who is with an unpleasant mind (or) one who is depressed.
maṅkucitta: [Maṅku+citta] (na) CL=7 Powerless mind. Upset mind (or) unpleasant mind.
maṅkukaraṇa: [Maṅku+karaṇa] (ti) CL=7 Can be made to be a powerless (or) unpleasant state.
maṅkukattukāma: [Maṅku+kattukāma] (ti) CL=7 One who is wishing to humiliate.
maṅkulabhatta: [Maṅkula+bhatta] (na) CL=7 The food of bed bugs. Bed-bug-food.
maṅkura: [Maka=maṅka+ura] (pu) CL=7 [Maki+uraca. Thoma] (1) A high official of the royal court named Maṅkura. (2) The mirror.
maṅkuṇa: [Maki+uṇa] (pu) CL=7 [In Sakkata there are "matthuṇa" words. Madadhāta guṇadhāta]. A bed bug. See - Maṅkuṇasaṅgha.
maṅkuṇasaṅgha: [Maṅkuṇa+saṅgha] (pu) CL=7 A group of bed bugs.
maṅgalasayutta: [Maṅgala+saṃyutta] (ti) CL=7 Connected to blessing. Have blessed.
